content:
Hello and good evening!

@Don Sizemore wanted to know if it was possible to translate the Ansible SchemaSpy generation step into GitHub Actions.

I've opened a PR here: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pull/12901 and an issue here: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/issues/12900

It slots directly into the test pipeline that is already built. It doesn't add any extra wall clock load to CI/CD, not even a minute.

It runs directly after the API tests, while the [Firefox, Webkit] matrix is running to use that dead time. It uploads a schemaspy- tar artifact that will remain valid for 14 days.

Can we get this merged for 6.13, @Philip Durbin 🚀 ?? Really sorry to be so pushy, but it'll be a major QoL improvement for my team here at UNC. Right now, they're booting up a whole EC2 server with Dataverse-Ansible, and doing the schemaspy step manually.

It's a small highly targeted change, that takes little CI time
